**CINNOX plan quick reference** (contact sales for binding quotes)

| Plan | Target | DID slots | IDD incl. | SSO/AD | Dedicated CSM |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials | SMB, single channel | 1 | no | no | no |
| Professional | Mid-market | up to 3 | limited pool | paid add-on | no |
| Enterprise | Large, multi-channel | up to 10 | included pool | included | shared |
| Enterprise Plus | Global accounts | custom | custom | included | dedicated |

Exact prices, included minute pools, and contract terms are provided by the sales team.
